note: PRIORITY Appliance Service commercial repair invoice (Miele fridge). Anchors: (1) service_address is the 'Service Location' block (5189 CAMBIE ST # 111, VANCOUVER), NOT the Paying Party (13988 MAYCREST WAY # 155 = Noble's own address); (2) pst_amount 34.75 -- a rare invoice that actually charges BC PST, so it exercises real PST extraction rather than the default-0 path. total 1016.93 = Invoice Total (Parts 496.41 + Labor 439.00 + PST 34.75 + GST 46.77); no carried-forward, Payments Received blank. po 11022266 ('# 11022266', 110-prefix) -> sub_bill_type derived 'repair'. vendor passes on twin agreement (both below the 0.73 bar but identical). billing-period fields blank (one-time repair). || NOT asserted here: invoice_date (the 'Date Order Taken and Completed' values 8/6/25 & 4/27/26 are slashed/ambiguous -> _normalize_date rejects them, so 2 of 3 runs defaulted to today); payment_due_date (none printed -> defaults to today+30); invoice_description. || Narrative fields NOT asserted here: diagnosis_solution, diagnosis_solution_zh_hant, recommendation, recommendation_zh_hant, warranty -- free-text summaries that reword themselves across replicates. The commercial narrative anchors are diag_260106_0008 (no-fault diagnosis, empty recommendation and warranty), warranty_260120_0062 (goods sale, empty recommendation) and recommend_240124_0001 (warranty disclaimer). || vendor_name VALUE is no longer asserted, but routingDecision now IS and is meaningful. This invoice prints its real vendor only as a stylized logo; the plain text nearest the letterhead is the dispatch service in the top-right contact block, so vendor_name_extract takes that instead. Measured at n=12 on the UNMODIFIED HEAD analyzer: the correct vendor came out 2/12 and routing was HAPPY_PATH only 2/12 -- the previous assertions here were a ~17% outcome frozen by the cache, not a stable result. The domain-corroboration tiebreak (field_policy.vendor_domain_tiebreak) now settles it from www.priorityappliance.com / dispatch@priorityappliance.com, giving HAPPY_PATH 12/12 on BOTH the HEAD and current analyzers. The written form still alternates between the normalised generate name ('Priority Appliance', 8/12) and the printed extract name ('PRIORITY appliance service', 4/12) -- both correct, so the form is not asserted while the routing is. || account_number IS asserted null from 2026-08-18 and this doc is the A5 anchor. The invoice prints '# 11022266' beside the paying party -- its job number -- and carries no customer account anywhere, yet the analyzer returned that number as account_number on all 31 cached replicates, auto-written because account_number is critical on municipal only. gates.evaluate now discards an account_number whose digits equal the resolved PO on a page printing no account label at all; asserting null is what would catch it returning. || C2 2026-08-18: amount_excluding_gst 970.16 asserted -- derived as total_invoice_amount - gst_amount = 1016.93 - 46.77, stable on all 31 cached replicates. || folio_number ADDED 2026-09-09 with the new folio twins (commercial-narrative-v20). It is a critical field on property tax notices only (field_policy.PROPERTYTAX_DELTA), and is asserted on every sidecar -- the value on a tax notice, "" everywhere else -- so a regression that starts populating it on ordinary invoices is caught.
